detail.longDescription: If anyone is interested, as part of learning how programming languages are designed and work, I've been designing my own. I've used Claude to create some examples and docs, and I've tried to come up with something that I'd like to work with that is hopefully also easy for AI to work with, even though no examples live anywhere online. If anyone would care to take a look and let me know what you think I'd be very grateful. Thank you https:// github.com/Antnee/nib # Programming # NibLang
